views.stdout:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'krusgraph') EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA [krusgraph]');
GO
-- order_items is a fact table (4 dimensions joined in through the plan's relationships)
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [krusgraph].[vw_order_items] AS
SELECT
    f.[order_id] AS [order_id],
    f.[line_no] AS [line_no],
    f.[product_id] AS [product_id],
    f.[quantity] AS [quantity],
    d1.[order_id] AS [orders_order_id],
    d1.[customer_id] AS [orders_customer_id],
    d1.[order_date] AS [orders_order_date],
    d1.[ship_to_id] AS [orders_ship_to_id],
    d2.[product_id] AS [products_product_id],
    d2.[name] AS [products_name],
    d2.[category_id] AS [products_category_id],
    d3.[customer_id] AS [customers_customer_id],
    d3.[name] AS [customers_name],
    d3.[country] AS [customers_country],
    d4.[id] AS [categories_id],
    d4.[name] AS [categories_name]
FROM [dbo].[order_items] AS f
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[orders] AS d1 ON f.[order_id] = d1.[order_id]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[products] AS d2 ON f.[product_id] = d2.[product_id]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[customers] AS d3 ON d1.[customer_id] = d3.[customer_id]
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[categories] AS d4 ON d2.[category_id] = d4.[id];
GO
-- orders is a header table: order_items holds its lines; one row per orders row, with its 1 dimension(s) joined in
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [krusgraph].[vw_orders] AS
SELECT
    f.[order_id] AS [order_id],
    f.[customer_id] AS [customer_id],
    f.[order_date] AS [order_date],
    f.[ship_to_id] AS [ship_to_id],
    d1.[customer_id] AS [customers_customer_id],
    d1.[name] AS [customers_name],
    d1.[country] AS [customers_country]
FROM [dbo].[orders] AS f
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[customers] AS d1 ON f.[customer_id] = d1.[customer_id];
GO
